title: Apply-Restructure Manifest
description: Definition manifest and derived worker targets. Version 2 records complete geometry ownership, structural classification, occurrence contexts and independent inventory. Legacy phase4_targets fields remain accepted. Residual source geometry is accounted for during assessment; aggregate outputs may not own geometry.

assembly_root.description: Source residual geometry tracked until assigned to an output child asset; an aggregate output must own no geometry.

path.description: The new assembly-root file path; matches the phase4_targets[] assembly_root entry path when residual meshes exist.

mesh_count.description: Authoritative default-predicate mesh count remaining on the assembly root after extraction (len of Usd.PrimRange.Stage(stage, Usd.PrimDefaultPredicate) filtered to UsdGeom.Mesh).

phase4_targets.description: Written definition targets plus residual assembly geometry. Existing path, target_class and mesh_count remain required. Scoped merges additionally declare the retained boundary, protected children and exact selected meshes.

path.description: Written file Phase 4 must optimize. This is the reconciliation key against optimization-report.target_coverage[].path.

mesh_count.description: Authoritative default-predicate mesh count: len of Usd.PrimRange.Stage(stage, Usd.PrimDefaultPredicate) filtered to UsdGeom.Mesh, measured when the target is opened standalone (matches the apply-restructure Postcondition). The Phase-4 completion gate accepts disposition 'skipped_zero_meshes' only when this is 0.

level.description: Logical assembly/component/subcomponent level. This does not require authoring USD kind metadata; do not nest component models.

importance.description: Target-tree tag. Descend to `subcomponent` only for `important` sub-hierarchies. Also a functional-tolerance signal input (with `articulated`) for the auto-within-tolerance lossy gate in operation-safety.md.

articulated.description: Target-tree tag. True for articulated / physics / variant-bearing nodes. Articulated assets instance at rigid-body/link level (factory guide Step 4), never whole-asset. Also a functional-tolerance signal that drops bounded-loss ops from auto-within-tolerance back to intent-gated.

archetype.description: Target-tree tag, derived from semantic_label + structural signals. Selects which Phase-4 op-chain steps apply and the per-target scale-banded tolerance (see workflow.md op chain + usd-optimize-run-operations/references/units-and-tolerances.md).

descent_level.description: Descent frontier level. Carries the resume-from-existing-level entry point: when the input arrives already instanced / BIM-CAD-exported, the descent ENTERS at the level the asset is already at rather than restarting from the top.

identity_disposition.description: Frontier Axis A (where the definition lives; identity preserved). externalize_shared = nested external referenced prototype reused across components; internal_share = shared inside one parent; keep_local = meaningful one-off cleaned in place.

reduction_route.description: Geometry operation, independent of definition sharing. A merge with a validated interior operation_scope retains boundary_path; an unscoped merge or point_instance can remove identity and retains the existing explicit-authorization requirement.

identity_signal.description: Which signal set the grain (the queryable boundary basis). kind/naming/semantic = STRONG authored identity; structural_fallback = identity absent, the coarsest repeating subtree proposed the grain (never a leaf); none = anonymous geometry. REQUIRED on every shared (externalize_shared/internal_share) or identity-destroying (point_instance/merge) entry. A shared entry with identity_signal=none (landed on anonymous meshes) fails the contract; an identity-destroying route on a strong-identity unit (kind/naming/semantic) fails the contract.

grain_source.description: Whether the grain came from authored identity (default) or the structural-fallback (coarsest repeating subtree where identity is absent). When this is structural_fallback, identity_signal is emitted as 'structural_fallback' — the two agree, and 'none' is reserved for a grain that has no fallback justification either.

intent_confirmed.description: The user explicitly confirmed an identity-destroying reduction_route (point_instance / merge) on a unit that would otherwise be refused it — the one exemption to the strong-identity rule. select_frontier.py writes it when it grants the exemption, so the manifest gate can honour the same call instead of re-failing the run. Absent means no confirmation was given.

kind_untrusted.description: Kind-trust preflight (finder spec §6.0.1, issue #172): true when this unit carried an authored kind that was demoted STAGE-WIDE because kind does not partition geometry (~1 mesh per component on monolithic CAD imports). The grain was re-derived structurally (grain_source=structural_fallback); the frontier.kind_trust block carries the sampled stats that justified the demotion.

value_variant_id.description: Value-variant partition id within a structural group (one prototype per genuine variant, e.g. a group of 18 near-identical copies that partitions into 17 identical plus 1 real variant).

value_variant_count.description: Number of genuine value-variants in this candidate's structural group.

nested_parent_proto.description: The parent prototype that references this one (the nested-library link; parents reference child prototypes, not inline copies).

own_prims.description: NON-double-counted own prim count (a parent and its nested child do not both claim the same savings).

copy_count.description: Number of occurrences of this unit across distinct parents.

below_externalization_cutoff.description: Input condition (not a disposition): the candidate did not pass the band-resolved externalization cutoff (copy_count / own-size). decision_reason carries the route taken.

kept_inline_for_merge.description: Sub-MINP leaf intentionally NOT instanced so a later within-prototype mesh-merge can fuse it (instancing finely bakes in granularity a merge pass would have to tear down).

arc_estimate.description: Load-bearing anti-failure evidence: arcs if shared at the frontier vs arcs at mesh level (empirically ~100-150 vs ~156,691). A descent that explodes arcs without reusing proportionally more DISTINCT data is too deep.

package_group.description: Advisory packaging grouping hint (discipline / system / family library) when externalized. Must not pull deployment packaging forward.

frontier_estimate_basis.description: Set to spot_check when the cost guard degraded the frontier scan to a masked spot-check on a large stage.

decision_reason.description: Audit trail of the boundary call (NOT free text): which identity signal set the grain and which stop condition or descend trigger fired. Makes a too-deep or identity-destroying choice visible and reviewable rather than silent.

weight_hints.description: Optional pre-extraction estimates for adaptive batching. NON-authoritative; mesh_count above is the authoritative count the gate uses.

boundary_path.description: Retained component or subcomponent Xform in the written definition.

protected_paths.description: Retained child components and addressed semantic, animation or physics prims.

preservation_policy.description: Path to the versioned stage-verification policy JSON, relative to this manifest.

definition_id.description: Definition identity within the writer layer. Omit only for legacy file-level coverage.

frontier.description: Descent frontier summary. Carries the MEASURED remaining reuse so a scene-graph / consolidation win can only be reported from measurement, never estimated. When any phase4_targets[] entry is a shared (externalize_shared / internal_share) disposition, reuse_measured MUST be true (a consolidation claim requires measurement). When measured reuse is low, the plan pivots to the disk tier rather than forcing more sharing.

reuse_measured.description: True when the remaining reuse was MEASURED (distinct vs total prototypes/units), not estimated. Required true whenever a shared disposition is claimed.

descent_entry_level.description: Resume-from-existing-level: the level the descent ENTERED at when the input arrived already partway down (already instanced / BIM-CAD). The stop/descend rules are unchanged from there.

descent_converged.description: Convergence gate: true only when a re-run of the reuse analyzer on the authored structure surfaced NO new shareable group above the inclusion floor (MINP, occurrence >=2) — the descent reached a fixpoint. The remaining residue is sub-MINP kept_inline_for_merge leaves, already-split value-variants, or unique content. Phase 4 geometry ops (decimation, within-prototype merge) must NOT run until this is true; otherwise geometry is reduced/merged on a structure further sharing would still have collapsed, and a merge runs before its kept_inline_for_merge leaves were reserved.

final_rescan_new_groups_above_floor.description: Evidence for descent_converged: the number of NEW shareable groups above the inclusion floor that the final convergence re-scan found. 0 == converged. A positive value with descent_converged=true is a contradiction the contract should reject.

low_reuse_disk_tier_pivot.description: True when measured reuse was low (e.g. parametric MEP geometry, mostly unique) and the plan pivoted to the disk tier (unused-primvar removal, primitive-fit, decimation) instead of forcing sharing.

by_identity_signal.description: Optional audit rollup: count of phase4_targets[] by their identity_signal. A quick read of how much of the frontier rests on strong authored identity (kind/naming/semantic) vs the structural_fallback grain vs anonymous (none). Additive; emitted by select_frontier.py.

by_disposition.description: Optional audit rollup: count of phase4_targets[] by their identity_disposition. Additive; emitted by select_frontier.py.

by_stop_condition.description: Optional audit rollup: count of phase4_targets[] by their decision_reason.stop_condition. Additive; emitted by select_frontier.py.

kind_trust.description: Optional audit block (finder spec §6.0.1, issue #172): the stage-wide meshes-per-kind preflight stats, so a sampled-and-REJECTED kind is auditable in the manifest (why kind-labeled units arrived as structural_fallback / kind_untrusted). Additive; emitted by the finder's --emit-candidates packet and passed through by select_frontier.py.

kind_trusted.description: False when kind failed the preflight (single_mesh_fraction >= max_single_mesh_fraction OR median_meshes_per_kind <= 1) and kind-derived identity was demoted.

sampled_kind_prims.description: Stage-wide sample size: walked prims with an authored kind in {component, subcomponent, group}.

single_mesh_fraction.description: Fraction of sampled kind prims whose subtree holds <= 1 mesh.

median_meshes_per_kind.description: Median subtree mesh count across the sample (null when the sample is empty).

max_single_mesh_fraction.description: The KIND_TRUST_MAX_SINGLE_MESH_FRACTION threshold the run used (default 0.80).

articulation_check.description: Whether the walk-up articulation stop could consult UsdPhysics; 'unavailable' means the guard was skipped gracefully.
